6 6 6 6 6 9 6 6 6 9 6 6 6
6 6 6 6 6 9 6 6 6 9 6 6 6
6 6 6 6 6 9 6 6 6 9 6 6 6
6 6 6 6 6 9 6 6 6 9 6 6 6'''
g=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in g_txt.splitlines()]
from collections import deque
R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); q=deque()
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if (r in (0,R-1) or c in (0,C-1)) and g[r][c]==6:
   seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))
while q:
 r,c=q.popleft()
 for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
  x,y=r+dr,c+dc
  if 0<=x<R and 0<=y<C and g[x][y]==6 and (x,y) not in seen:
   seen.add((x,y));q.append((x,y))
out=[[4 if v==6 and (r,c) not in seen else v for c,v in enumerate(row)] for r,row in enumerate(g)]
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
print('nonoutside',[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==6 and (r,c) not in seen])
